terse-reviewer 0.3.0

Harness: codex
Preferred route: codex-plugin (availability checked during install)
Package: terse-reviewer
Adapter: codex
- no-todo-comments: native (warn tool)
  needs: agent, tool.added
  -> tool.post warn (native); capabilities: add-context, system-message
- style: native (inject system)
  needs: agent
  -> static:developer_instructions inject (native)
- session-info: native (inject system)
  needs: agent, model, thinking_effort
  -> session.start inject (native); capabilities: add-context
  -> prompt.submitted inject (native); capabilities: add-context
- low-effort-guard: native (inject system)
  needs: agent, thinking_effort
  -> session.start inject (native); capabilities: add-context
  -> prompt.submitted inject (native); capabilities: add-context
- review-skill: native (inject skill)
  needs: agent
  -> tool.post inject (native); capabilities: add-context
  -> skill.explicit inject (native); capabilities: add-context
  ! Codex skill hooks observe explicit $name and local SKILL.md reads; cloud skill reads are unsupported by this route
- after-git-diff: native (inject tool)
  needs: agent, tool.input.command
  -> tool.post inject (native); capabilities: add-context
- before-create-pr: native (inject mcp)
  needs: agent
  -> tool.pre inject (native); capabilities: add-context
- no-force-push: native (block tool)
  needs: agent, tool.input.command
  -> tool.pre block (native); capabilities: deny
- on-review-prompt: native (warn event)
  needs: agent, harness.name, model, prompt
  -> prompt.submitted warn (native); capabilities: add-context, system-message
- codex-only-notify: native-hook (native)
  -> native Stop; timeout 60s
